subject: Request: Concession for premium implementation + custom connector
messages:
From: Anna Belmont <anna.belmont@elaratech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation + connector scope — pricing question

Marcus — thanks again for the demo this morning. We have strong internal momentum at Elara to move forward but there are two items blocking procurement: the custom CRM connector (will need mapping for ~12 custom fields and event backfills) and the level of go-live support.

Would Redwood be able to include the Premium Implementation package (30 days dedicated onboarding, 3 weeks of bi-weekly architecture calls, and 40 migration hours) as part of the first-year package, and also deliver the CRM connector as part of the initial SOW? Elara is asking for this bundled into year one pricing — we’re evaluating other vendors and that inclusion is a gating factor.

I’ve attached a short spec for the connector. If you can send a bundled price and lead time today that would help speed our procurement.

Thanks,
Anna Belmont
Senior Product Manager
Elara Technology

Attachments: connector-specs-elara.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Belmont <anna.belmont@elaratech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation + connector scope — pricing question

Anna — appreciate the spec and the urgency. Internal note: I’m proposing the following concession to close the deal quickly given the strategic fit (security-conscious healthcare vertical customer, potential ARR > $1.1M over 3 years).

Proposal (what I’d like Deal Desk / Exec to approve):
- Include Redwood Premium Implementation for Year 1 at no additional charge (30 days onboarding + 40 hours migration).
- Custom CRM connector to be delivered as part of the initial SOW; include up to 80 dev hours (for mapping + backfills) at a concession rate of $0 (i.e., Redwood absorbs first 80 hours), additional hours billed at standard PS rates.
- A one-time commercial concession: 20% discount off list professional services fees for Year 1.
- Standard product pricing to remain at quoted levels (no discount to product list beyond PS concession).

I’m attaching the draft SOW and a pricing matrix. Jordan — can you validate that the finance impact (ARR, margin) is consistent with our thresholds? Lauren — requesting your signoff to escalate to Evelyn for exec approval.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-Elara-v2.pdf, pricing-matrix-elara.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 12:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation + connector scope — pricing question

Marcus — reviewed the numbers quickly. A couple asks before we elevate:
1) Can you confirm expected 12-month ARR and TCV if Elara accepts the above? Need to show net revenue impact after absorbing 80 PS hours.
2) Are there any non-standard legal terms requested by procurement (data residency, indemnity changes)? They flagged an unusual audit clause in their initial redline.
3) Recommend we add a deliverable acceptance definition for the connector to avoid scope creep (suggest: acceptance test plan + KPIs).

If you can include bullets for the above, I’ll model the margin and push to Finance for quick review.

-Jordan
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation + connector scope — pricing question

Jordan — answers below to include in the Deal Desk packet: 
1) Financials: 12-month ARR = $385,000; TCV (year 1 product + PS concession) = $420,000. Absorbing 80 PS hours reduces FY1 professional services revenue by ~$48k (based on standard PS rate). Net product margin remains ~68% after concession.
2) Legal: Procurement requested a limited data processing addendum and a clause for SOC 2 audit evidence; they flagged an "audit right" paragraph that we pushed back on (we offered scoped audit access via secure share only). No material indemnity changes requested.
3) Acceptance: proposing acceptance criteria: connector acceptance when Elara can sync a 30-day event history across 3 test accounts, with mappings for the 12 fields and timing SLA of delta < 5 seconds for real-time events. Failure leads to remediation plan; additional dev hours billed as change order.

I’ve updated the SOW to include acceptance criteria and copies of the finance summary. Requesting Lauren to escalate to Evelyn for final signoff on the concession (absorbing 80 PS hours + 20% PS discount).

Marcus

Quoted attachments: technical-connector-specs.docx

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Concession for premium implementation + custom connector — need exec approval

Evelyn — looping you in for an exec concession on Elara. Quick summary in-line: 
- Potential strategic customer (healthcare vertical) w/ expected ARR $385k first 12 months, strong expansion potential.
- Request: cover Premium Implementation Year 1 + absorb first 80 PS hours for the CRM connector; 20% discount on PS fees Year 1. Product list pricing unchanged.
- Finance has modeled margin impact; net product margin still acceptable (~68%). Legal confirmed no material contract liabilities beyond scoped audit access.

Asking for approval to finalize and instruct Deal Desk to accept the concession. We should limit this approval to this specific deal and require reporting of actual PS hours used during onboarding.

Thanks,
Lauren
VP, Americas Sales
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Concession for premium implementation + custom connector — need exec approval

All — reviewed. Approve the concession under the following controls: 
1) Approval limited to Deal ID RDW-DEAL-4729 and expires if the contract is not signed within 45 days.
2) Require weekly PS hour burn-rate reporting to Sales Ops until onboarding is complete. Any deviation >20% requires prior approval from Finance.
3) Cap total absorbed PS hours at 80. Additional work must be documented as change order with client sign-off.
4) No product list discount allowed. Any future pricing concessions must be re-evaluated at renewal.

Please proceed to finalize the SOW and route for signature. Jordan — flag to Finance that this is approved with reporting controls so they can update margin tracking.

Evelyn Hart
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
